title: A goal
summary: A savings goal, a progress bar and a percentage.
done: You saw a percentage and an “if … else”.

hello.text: In level 3, a savings goal and a bar that fills up.

bar.text: The **percentage**: total ÷ goal × 100. 10 € out of 20 € is 50: the bar is half full.

min.text: [constrain … low 0 high 100]: the bar never goes below 0 or above 100.

reached.text: If the total reaches the goal, we celebrate; else, we say how much is missing.

goal.text: The 🎯 button changes the goal, only if the number typed is above 0.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Add money: the bar block lights up.
watch.hint: Type a number in the preview, then tap “+ Add”.

party.text: Celebrate the goal with a short message.
party.hint: In the first branch of the [if].

color.text: Change the colour of the bar when the goal is reached.
color.hint: [set color of GoalBar to …] in the [if].
